body:
New features/changes since Nov 11
- add new Pkg deps for testing `PkgUtility`
- CanopyLayers
  - add fluspect example in docs
  - rename container to cache (more accurate definition)
  - remove iLAI from Canopy4RT and calculate it within functions
  - add functions to calculate remote sense products, such as EVI, NDVI, NIRv, and SIF
- PlantHydraulics
  - add PV curve functions
  - add non-steady state mode flow
  - add capacitance functions and fields
  - add diurnal cycle example
  - rename many functions to be more general
  - make xylem slice number flexible (instead of a fix number 10)
  - add segmented PV curve
  - use Organ and Organism instead of HS
- StomataModels
  - update functions to use refactored PlantHydraulics
  - make Wang model at whole plant level
- SoilPlantAirContinuum
  - reorganize the tests
  - use new PlantHydraulics
title: Wyujie
